faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Answers about buying and selling AI agents on AgentsHub.
faq.subtitle: Short answers to the questions people ask most.
faq.more: Still have a question? Ask in the

what.a: A marketplace where independent creators list AI agents, and businesses post briefs for the agents they need.

contact.q: How do I buy an agent?
contact.a: Open the agent, check its price and demo, then contact the creator by email or WhatsApp. Payment and setup are agreed directly with them.

contacts.q: Who can see my email and WhatsApp?
contacts.a: Only signed-in members. Guests never see contact details.

pricing.q: What do the price types mean?
pricing.a: Free, one-time, monthly subscription, or custom quote. All prices are in USD.

brief.a: A short description of an agent you need. Creators ask questions in the comments and contact you directly. Budget and deadline are optional.

deadline.q: What happens when my brief's deadline passes?
deadline.a: Nothing automatic: the brief stays open until you close it. To reopen a closed brief whose deadline has passed, set a new date or remove it.

rank.q: How are creators and agents ranked?
rank.a: Every night, from likes and views by other members. Your own likes and views don't count.

pause.q: Can I hide an agent for a while?
pause.a: Yes. Pause it in My agents: it disappears from the marketplace until you activate it again.

password.a: Password recovery isn't available yet. Contact support from the email linked to your account.

blocked.q: Why was I signed out with a "blocked" message?
blocked.a: An admin blocked the account. Contact support if you think it's a mistake.

about.title: About AgentsHub
about.description: Why AgentsHub exists and how it works.
about.lead: AgentsHub connects businesses with independent creators of AI agents — in the open, with clear prices and private contacts.

why.title: Why we built it
why.text: Small businesses want automation but don't know where to start. Creators build great agents but struggle to be found. AgentsHub puts both in one place.

how.title: How it works
how.text: Creators list agents with a price and screenshots. Businesses browse, or post a brief when nothing fits. Questions happen in public comments; deals happen directly.

principles.title: What we care about
principles.text: Private contacts, honest prices in USD, and a ranking based on what other members like — not on how much you post.
